annotations.title: What a software development quote should include

description: Lists, in Hebrew, the 8 things a quote for building an app or software should state in writing: what is in the first version and what is not, fixed price or hourly, payment by stages, timeline, who owns the code and the store accounts, maintenance after launch, how scope changes are handled, and who actually builds. For each: why it matters and the question to ask the vendor when it is missing. Pass the items the quote already covers to get back only what is missing. Use when someone received a development quote, or several quotes far apart, and wants to know what to check before signing. It gives no verdict on whether a quote is fair, and it is not legal advice.

covered.description: Items the quote already states in writing, optional. scope = מה נכנס לגרסה הראשונה, ומה לא; pricing_model = מחיר קבוע או לפי שעות; payment_stages = תשלום לפי שלבים; timeline = לוח זמנים; ownership = של מי הקוד והחשבונות; maintenance = תחזוקה אחרי ההשקה; scope_change = שינוי בהיקף באמצע; who_builds = מי בונה בפועל
